lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance blobs posterior to the gills, forming four discernible vertical columns and three horizontal rows aligned with structural ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical light-intensity bands intersecting with three horizontal carinae to form anchor points for the primary lateral spot constellation.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges traversing the flank; the central ridge is most prominent, exhibiting a stark pixel intensity gradient with shadow cast immediately below the ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance blobs within the dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated in the posterior half and basal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch present on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of smaller high-luminance spots on the leading edge and distal tip of the pectoral fin.
